import Mathlib.NumberTheory.LSeries.PrimesInAP

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option Elab.async false

namespace PrimeFactorOscillations.QRHSpecification

-- These predicates are elaborated with Mathlib imports only.
def zetaSevenEighths : Prop :=
  forall s : Complex, (7 / 8 : Real) < s.re -> Not (riemannZeta s = 0)

def dirichletSevenEighths : Prop :=
  forall (q : Nat) [NeZero q] (chi : DirichletCharacter Complex q) (s : Complex),
    (7 / 8 : Real) < s.re -> Not (chi = 1 /\ s = 1) ->
      Not (DirichletCharacter.LFunction chi s = 0)

end PrimeFactorOscillations.QRHSpecification

#check "QRH_MATHLIB_TARGET_COMPLETE"
